default.title: QuickBooks posting evidence and preorder reconciliation
default.summary: ClawPilot now links prepaid Toast orders across payment and fulfillment dates, refreshes QuickBooks evidence on demand, and explains the exact mapping or review action required before posting.
features: A bounded Sync QuickBooks and recheck action with visible evidence freshness
Linked preorder lifecycles showing payment date, fulfillment date, document roles, check count, and Toast tips
Historical posting bundles that recognize multiple Sales Receipts per settlement journal and journal-only prepaid captures
Specific mapping guidance and an explicit regenerate handoff after configuration changes
fixes: A valid general settlement mapping now satisfies single-brand card payments
Future fulfillment documents are shown as scheduled instead of missing from QuickBooks
Payment Exceptions cannot silently reuse the POS clearing account
Toast tip evidence is shown separately from Sales Receipt totals
